description: This Java source file defines the PoliciesMappingStrategies class, which extends MappingStrategies to manage JSON serialization strategies for policy-related classes in the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes singleton management, strategy configuration, and references to various policy model classes and utilities.

classes.name: PoliciesMappingStrategies
classes.description: A singleton class extending MappingStrategies that manages JSON serialization strategies for policies and related entities, facilitating polymorphic JSON conversion within the Policies service.

methods.description: Constructor initializing the mapping strategies using predefined configurations.
